fusions.name: Door-Aimed Cast
fusions.desc: A hurled lance that deals 42 damage, leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 8 seconds, and is always a critical hit.

fusions.name: Twin Points
fusions.desc: Looses 2 points at once, spread apart, each dealing 7 damage. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Closing Lunge
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 5 tiles. Using it increases your movement speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Through the Gap
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 20% of the target's armour. It also reduces the cooldown of every other ability you have by 5%.
